steps.name: Back up acme.localhost with its files in /Users/you/dev/move-src
Create acme.localhost in /Users/you/dev/move-tgt and restore that backup into it (new-site, restore, encryption key)
Check that acme.localhost lists the same apps in /Users/you/dev/move-tgt (it shows the site opens there; the restore and the backups protect the data)
Back acme.localhost up again and drop it in /Users/you/dev/move-src as site drop does (database, folder to archived/sites)

stays: the backups of acme.localhost (they go with its folder to /Users/you/dev/move-src/archived/sites/acme.localhost, the second backup included)
a copy of the first backup set in /Users/you/.local/state/benchbar/backups
